author: Ozarks Mountain Brewery
title: Sierra Nevada Pale Ale Clone
instructions_list: Mash (Mash-out Rest) — Temperature at 168°F for 10 minutes.
Bring wort to a boil and boil for 70 minutes. Add hops: Magnum (Boil 60 min); Perle (Boil 30 min); Cascade (Boil 10 min); Cascade (Boil 0 min). Dry hop with Cascade after primary fermentation.
Ferment with Fermentis Safale - American Ale Yeast US-05.
